text: After a long day's work, you try to hit the hay...
But this NIGGA climbs in bed with you!
He climbs out of your bed and smiles at you as he leaves. Fucking creep.
So the next night, you lock your door and fall asleep...
But this fucking PRICK climbs through your window and he's back in your bed, holding you like he's the fucking big spoon.
Motherfucker, I swear to God. You kick him the fuck out of the house!
The next night you bolt the fucking windows down and go back to sleep...
You feel ceiling dust on your face. Fucking CHRIST ALMIGHTY! He's cutting a Looney Tunes ass hole in your ceiling.
You've had just about enough of his bullshit, so once again you kick his freaky ass to the curb!
You patch the hole, lay down in your bed and— goddammit, he's back in the house! He jumps into your bed.
Hold me baby... and don't let go...
